title: CivAgent Next canonical event
description: One canonical scientific fact in the Next event store (plan §11). One event per line, ordered by (matchId, generation, seq).

instrumentVersion.description: Semantic instrument class; legacy sentinel is legacy-cc-v5-<baseline short hash>.

generation.description: Immutable segment generation this event belongs to.

eventId.description: One canonical event (UUID on native; preserved legacy event_id on import).

sessionId.description: Durable agent session. null on legacy import (unobservable).

actor.description: Producer identity: regime id, judge, skill-learner, system, or an office/session id in the native epoch.

artifactRefs.description: Content addresses of durable raw bytes referenced by this event. Empty on legacy import (raw capture not preserved).

payloadDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical payload bytes.
